label_definitions.event_window_return_pct: Asset close return from the previous available session close to the first session close strictly after publication.
label_definitions.event_window_abnormal_return_pct: Event-window asset return minus SPY return over the same sessions.
label_definitions.forward_1d_return_pct: Asset close-to-close return from the event session to the following available session.
label_definitions.forward_1d_abnormal_return_pct: Forward asset return minus SPY return over the same sessions.

limitations: Daily close timestamps are approximated as 16:00 America/New_York.
Abnormal return is a simple SPY-relative return, not a causal estimate.
Headlines may be duplicated across sources and need deduplication before model fitting.
Ticker coverage is restricted to assets present in the downloaded adjusted-price table.
